purpose: Given the available devtools typer-commands and the natural-language-request, produce the correct typer CLI command.

instructions.instruction: We only want the CLI command as output. No explanations or additional text. The command will be immediately executed.
Focus on generating one or more python typer-based commands based on the natural-language-request.
All commands must be fully valid typer commands from the typer-commands file with arguments and flags inferred based on the natural-language-request.
Be sure to use - for the function names instead of _ (example: 'list-prs' instead of 'list_prs')
Don't use = for arguments, use spaces instead (example: 'list-prs --state open' instead of 'list-prs --state=open')
If multiple commands are requested chain them together with '&&' so they run back to back in the terminal only if the previous command succeeds.
If asked to run multiple commands be sure to use 'uv run python commands/devtools.py' as the prefix.
If the natural-language-request does not ask for a command that matches one in the typer-commands file, respond with an empty string.
